title: Jerusalem Artichoke Curry
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired curry made with Jerusalem artichokes and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add Jerusalem artichokes and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in Arabian spice blend, lemon juice, and tomato puree.
Bring to a simmer and cook until the artichokes are tender, about 15 minutes.
Stir in chickpeas and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
